_comment: The first-visit questions and how their answers rank what Home and Grow offer. The rules that read this are lib/learner/plan.js (the answers) and lib/learner/recommend.js (the ranking); this file is only the words and the numbers. Kept on the shelf under `storage-key`, so it follows the account like the level does.
_steps: In the order asked. `multi`: how many options may be picked (the first counts most); without it, one. `when`: asked only if every named answer is one of the listed ids (for a multi answer, if any picked one is). `fact`: shown after a pick, one per option id, or `*` for any; `stat` big, `body` under it, `source` small. Every number in a fact is from this app's own data, named in `source`. `check` is the optional three-tap placement: `levels` is the level each count right (0 to 3) points to.

steps.question: Why are you learning Arabic?
steps.hint: Pick up to 2. The first one counts most.

options.label: Understand the Qur’an
options.hint: Know what you read and hear in salah

options.label: Memorise the Qur’an
options.hint: Hifz, and keeping what you hold

options.label: Study the sciences
options.hint: Fiqh, aqidah, hadith from the books

options.label: Grammar, to read books
options.hint: Nahw and sarf, the classical way

understand.body: times the 382 words of the Words world appear in the Qur’an. The top ten alone: 7,430. قَالَ by itself: 1,719.
understand.source: 80% of Qur’anic Words, Dr Abdulazeez Abdulraheem

memorise.body: groups of look-alike verses in Similar, the ones easiest to mix up. Memorise hides words and checks your recital.

speak.body: spoken dialects, from Egyptian to Moroccan, plus Fusha. Phrases are read aloud.

sciences.body: fiqh lessons from Mukhtasar al-Quduri, chapter by chapter. Plus al-Tahawi’s creed and an-Nawawi’s Forty.

grammar.body: lessons on al-Ajurrumiyya, the first grammar book. And Nahw explains any sentence you type: every word’s role, and why.

dawah.body: common questions in 8 topics, each answered with its evidence.

no.body: letters. A fully vowelled Qur’an marks every sound, so once you know the letters, the page tells you how to say each word.

slow.body: at a time is how speed comes: each word you know is read faster next time. Lessons show every word fully vowelled.

yes.body: Then words are your quickest win. Knowing what you read starts now.

*.body: answers and Tafheem checks this for you: 80% right moves you up, under 60% brings you back. Change it any time until then.

items.question: Which one is “the book”?
items.after: ال makes a word “the”. That is the very first Basics lesson.

items.question: What does رَبّ mean?
items.after: رَبّ comes 970 times in the Qur’an. You will meet it often.

items.question: In ذَهَبَ الوَلَدُ, what is الوَلَدُ?
items.after: The one who does the verb is raised, so it ends in ـُ. That is Nahw.

steps.question: Which language do you read meanings in?

*.body: Your answers count toward your level the same in either language.

steps.question: How much of the Qur’an do you know by heart?

options.label: Short surahs
options.hint: Juz ʿAmma or some of it

none.body: a day you already say the words of salah. The Prayer world teaches each phrase with its meaning.

amma.body: words hidden to start, then 1 in 3, then half, until you recite a page from memory.

few.body: look-alike verse groups in Similar help keep what you hold from mixing.

most.body: look-alike verse groups in Similar, and Memorise listens to your recital word by word.

steps.question: Which Arabic do you want to speak?

fusha.body: is the shared written Arabic and the Qur’an’s own language. A safe first step anywhere.

*.body: Everyday phrases in this dialect, read aloud.

steps.question: Do you follow a school of fiqh?

hanafi.body: Mukhtasar al-Quduri is a core Hanafi text. Fiqh will lead with it.

*.body: Fiqh today is al-Quduri, a Hanafi text. It stays open to you; it just won’t be pushed first.

5.body: of Arabic in a year, at 5 minutes a day. Daily goal: 20 XP.

10.body: of Arabic in a year, at 10 minutes a day. Daily goal: 50 XP.

20.body: of Arabic in a year, at 20 minutes a day. Daily goal: 100 XP.

_levels: The level answered, as a number: 0 cannot read the letters yet, 1 to 3 the three levels.json levels in order. `read` no is 0; otherwise `know` gives it, unless the check was taken and not set aside.
_places: What can be offered: a Grow world (`world`, a worlds.json id) or a tab (`tab`, a lib/nav/tabs.js id). `band`: the lowest and highest level (as above) it suits. `goals`: how much it serves each goal, 0 to 1. `times`: a multiplier when every named answer is one of the listed ids (as `when` above). Order breaks ties.
_rank: score = (goal + level) × fade + done. goal: each picked goal's weight, the first in full and the next × `second-goal`, × how well the level fits (1 inside the band, `near-level` one step out, 0 further). level: `level-weight` × that fit, for a place serving any picked goal. With no goal picked, `no-goal` weights stand in. fade = 1 / (1 + answers given / `fade-at`), so what was said counts half once `fade-at` answers are in (levels.json settles a level at the same 30). done: lib/grow/suggest.js's recent use × `done-weight`, which keeps a day's use near one goal's pull.
